args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18). Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: The `rollback` tool was persistently unavailable (503 after retries), so I used the `deploy` tool to deploy v2.3.0 to all production regions instead — this is the same outcome since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. The deploy succeeded and the service is now **healthy** (error rate 0.002) in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: the rollback tool itself was unavailable, so I used deploy as the alternative path to restore the healthy version.
